mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 84 degrees under overcast skies near Verona Area High School, with a new moon tonight.

The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a long-range guide for city infrastructure and sustainability. Additionally, engineering reports remain available for review on the city website.

Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more events on October 14 including the Downtown Farmer's Market.
Regarding the weekly report, on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at CTH-PB and CTH-M involving a 71-year-old driver.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day before they close at 10:00 PM.
